executiveComp.source: Form 990 FY2024 (UC Healthcare System, EIN 27-3850988); FY2024 filing did not itemize Part VII; breakdown unavailable. Former CEO Richard Lofgren reported $2,534,760 in FY2022 before departing for OU Health. Top physician Rani Nasser MD reported $1,600,000 in FY2024.

communityBenefit.source: Form 990 FY2024 grants/community benefit line; UC Health provides 100% free care at or below 150% FPL and discounted care up to 400% FPL per financial assistance policy

taxAdvantage.notes: UC Health has been tax-exempt since June 1996. Holds approximately $580M in outstanding bond debt including tax-exempt issues. Participates in 340B program as a DSH-qualifying entity. Precise annual tax advantage requires Schedule H, local property tax, and state exemption data not verified here.

layoffs.notes: UC Health eliminated 50 positions and sunset the mobile stroke unit, citing sustained industry challenges. Affected employees offered severance and internal transfer opportunities.

Over 500 healthcare support workers at West Chester Hospital and UC Medical Center lost jobs after UC Health did not renew contracts with food service company Morrison Healthcare and support company Crothall Healthcare. These were contract workers, not direct UC Health employees.

UC Health announced closure of the Daniel Drake Center for Post-Acute Care by September 30, 2025, with approximately 474 employees anticipated to be laid off. Impacted employees offered opportunity to pursue open positions within UC Health.
layoffs.source: WCPO; UC Health press release; Local12

facilityClosures.type: Post-acute care and skilled nursing facility
facilityClosures.notes: After 165 years of operation, UC Health announced closure citing sustained financial challenges related to facility age and services. Reported $19M in losses at the facility. UC Health also phasing out of skilled nursing and post-acute inpatient care entirely.
facilityClosures.source: WCPO; UC Health press release; Becker's Hospital Review

facilityClosures.notes: Mobile stroke unit eliminated as part of cost-cutting measures. Staff reassigned to other positions within UC Health.

accusation: UC Health holds $1.8 billion in total assets and $580 million in bond debt rated one notch above junk, yet in 2025 alone eliminated over 500 direct positions, shuttered the 165-year-old Daniel Drake Center, cut its mobile stroke unit, and carries nearly $18 in bond debt for every $1 of community benefit — all while maintaining tax-exempt status and providing the sideline medical team at Cincinnati Bengals games.
